title: ozoroa insignis subsp. latifolia
intro: Ozoroa insignis subsp. latifolia, commonly known as the Natal mahogany, is a plant species in the family Anacardiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in South African folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ozoroa insignis subsp. latifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, infections, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
